# SRS Roofing — LLM / AI-search summary

SRS Roofing is a Washington State roofing contractor providing residential and commercial roof installation, repair, and maintenance services. Founded in 2000. WA License SRSRORC765BS.

## Contact
- Phone (24/7, real technician answers): 360-220-8059
- Email: Info@srsroofing.com
- Canonical site: https://www.blackboxadvancements.com/srsroofing

## Primary services
- Residential Roofing (replacement, re-roof, new construction)
- Commercial Roofing (TPO, EPDM, PVC, modified bitumen, torch-down, metal)
- Roof Repair (leaks, flashing, storm damage, insurance claims)
- Roof Care Program (moss removal, gutter cleaning, inspections)

## Differentiators
- Lifetime workmanship warranty on every install
- 24/7 emergency leak response with a real technician answering the phone
- Typical quote-to-crew-on-site: as little as 8 hours on urgent jobs
- 25+ years in Washington roofing
- Residential, commercial, and emergency divisions — all under one roof

## Service area
Washington State — coverage from Whatcom and Skagit counties in the north through King, Snohomish, Pierce, Kitsap, Thurston, Clark, Yakima, Benton, Franklin, Spokane, Walla Walla and beyond. Franchise expansion markets include Ohio and North Carolina.

## Pricing ranges (Washington, 2026)
- Full residential replacement: $9,500 – $28,000
- Residential repair: $400 – $2,800
- Emergency leak-stop + investigation: $650 – $3,500
- Commercial re-roof or re-cover: varies by sqft and system
- Roof Care maintenance: $249–$549 per visit

## Estimator
A 2-minute online estimator is available at /estimator/ that returns a realistic price range before any on-site inspection.

## Warranty
All SRS installs are backed by a Lifetime Workmanship Warranty covering the company's installation (flashings, fasteners, underlayment, ventilation transitions). Shingles and membranes also carry the manufacturer's warranty.

## Materials installed
Asphalt 3-tab · Architectural shingle · Designer / luxury shingle · Standing-seam metal · Exposed-fastener metal · TPO · EPDM · PVC · Modified bitumen · Torch-down.
